summary: Kingsoft Cloud Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the filing of its annual report on Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025 and the release of its 2025 Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) Report. This is a routine regulatory filing and disclosure of periodic financial and ESG information, with no mention of any special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. The filing is a standard report of foreign issuer pursuant to Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. No deal terms or event-driven catalyst are present.
